001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service;
002
003import android.content.Context;
004import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
005import androidx.room.RoomDatabase;
006import androidx.sqlite.db.SupportSQLiteDatabase;
007import com.google.gson.Gson;
008import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext;
009import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.R;
010import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao.PinDao;
011import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.Pin;
012import io.reactivex.rxjava3.schedulers.Schedulers;
013import java.io.IOException;
014import java.io.InputStream;
015import java.io.InputStreamReader;
016import java.io.Reader;
017import javax.inject.Inject;
018import javax.inject.Provider;
019
020public class Preloader extends RoomDatabase.Callback {
021
022
023  private final Context context;
024  private final Provider<PinDao> pinDaoProvider;
025  private final Gson gson;
026
027  @Inject
028  Preloader(@ApplicationContext Context context, Provider<PinDao> pinDaoProvider, Gson gson) {
029    this.context = context;
030    this.pinDaoProvider = pinDaoProvider;
031    this.gson = gson;
032  }
033
034  @Override
035  public void onCreate(@NonNull SupportSQLiteDatabase db) {
036    super.onCreate(db);
037
038    PinDao pinDao = pinDaoProvider.get();
039
040    //Need an input stream
041    try (
042        InputStream input = context.getResources().openRawResource(R.raw.preload);
043        Reader reader = new InputStreamReader(input)
044    ) {
045      Pin[] pins = gson.fromJson(reader, Pin[].class);
046      pinDao
047          .insert(pins)
048          .subscribeOn(Schedulers.io())
049          .subscribe();
050
051    } catch (IOException e) {
052      throw new RuntimeException(e);
053    }
054
055  }
056}
